name: bvt-skills
description: Free Claude skills and plugins from the BitVault team: multilingual apps, token saving, crypto exchange and wallet architecture, and 50 engineering playbooks for localization, crypto apps and chain operations.

plugins.name: bvt-multi-language
plugins.description: Language switcher and full multilingual system for any website or app, translation into as many languages as possible, and a quality gate before release.

plugins.name: bvt-save-token
plugins.description: Use fewer tokens: short replies, diff-only code, chat handoff notes and a setup audit.

plugins.name: bvt-crypto-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture playbooks for a centralized crypto exchange and a self-custody wallet.

plugins.name: bvt-i18n-playbooks
plugins.description: 15 localization playbooks for crypto apps: i18n architecture, ICU messages, RTL, fonts, number, currency and date formats, seed phrase language rules, store listings, regulatory translation, AI translation QA and testing.

plugins.name: bvt-app-playbooks
plugins.description: 29 engineering playbooks for crypto wallet and exchange apps on mobile, desktop, web and browser extension: secure storage, biometrics, seed phrase UX, RPC resilience, React Native and Expo, Tauri, PWA, testing, store release and more.

plugins.name: bvt-chain-ops
plugins.description: 6 blockchain operations playbooks: Solidity standard with OpenZeppelin, multisig plus timelock governance, PoW multi-algorithm L1 operations, cloudflared and nginx edge ops, incident runbooks and project documentation rules.
